pages.text: [#](53341a)Fire is one of the oldest working tools in the craft, and the brazier is how you direct it. Load up to three ingredients by right-clicking; the bowl shows each offering as colored contents. Ignite it with **flint and steel**, then step back.[#]()
pages.title: The Brazier

pages.text: [#](53341a)Most brazier workings draw power from a valid altar within sixteen blocks. If the flame sputters smoke and fizz without finishing, the altar is missing, invalid, or out of power.[#]()
[#](53341a)Empty-hand use on a burning brazier gathers **Wood Ash** and cancels the burn; water clears it outright.[#]()
[#](53341a)Iron ingots and a stick. The brazier need not be complicated; what burns inside it often is.[#]()

[#](53341a)**Conjure Spectres** - Wormwood, Bat Wool, and Graveyard Dust. A Spectre emerges after thirty seconds of altar-fed flame, with a rare Poltergeist riding the smoke. **Conjure Banshees** - Wormwood, Condensed Fear, and Graveyard Dust.[#]()
pages.title: Named Workings

pages.text: [#](53341a)**Conjure Poltergeist** - Wormwood, Refined Evil, and Focused Will; this one needs no altar. Released spectral undead remember their summoner, ignore that owner, and can be strengthened with Graveyard Dust up to 50 health.[#]()

[#](53341a)**Anguish of the Dead** - Tear of the Goddess, Blaze Rod, and Golden Apple. Strength radiates outward. **Fortification of the Corpse** - Tear of the Goddess, Diamond, and Golden Apple. Resistance gathers nearby.[#]()

[#](53341a)**Deathly Veil** - Fermented Eye, Ender Pearl, and Diamond. Light passes through. **Drain Growth** - Condensed Fear, Wormy Apple, and Graveyard Dust. Crops regress and undead knit together.[#]()

[#](53341a)**Graveyard Mist** - Nether Wart, Quicklime, and Blaze Powder. You will know it by the smoke. **Quick burnings** - Infernal Animus; Exhale of the Horned One; Rowan Berries; Fanciful Thread; Diamond Vapour with Fanciful Thread; or Gunpowder.[#]()
[#](53341a)These release their nearby player effects after a short burn.[#]()
